errors.text_span: Вертикалната ос е с линеен мащаб
errors.evidence: The vertical axis is categorical, listing the different barriers. It is the horizontal axis that has a linear scale representing percentages.

errors.text_span: категориите са подредени в произволен ред
errors.evidence: The categories are not in a random order. They are sorted by the length of their corresponding bars in ascending order from top to bottom.
The shortest bar in the chart represents a value of approximately 48%, not 10%. No bar is close to 10%.

errors.text_span: илюстрирайки фактори като "достъп до експертни консултации" и "време за комуникация и обратна връзка"
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly identifies which factors correspond to the shortest bars. The factors mentioned ('достъп до експертни консултации' and 'време за комуникация и обратна връзка') have values of approximately 59% and 63% respectively, which are in the middle of the range, not the shortest. The actual shortest bar is 'достъп до примери за успешно приложение на иновации' (~48%).

errors.text_span: Най-високите стълбове показват стойности близо до 90%
errors.evidence: The highest bar in the chart has a value of approximately 78%. This is a significant overestimation and not 'close to 90%'.

While 'време за подготовка на казуса' (~72%) is one of the higher values, it is not one of the 'highest' in the same way as the single longest bar, 'време за подготовка на иновативни методи' (~78%). Grouping it this way is slightly misleading.
